CASE STUDY · GTM SYSTEMS · AUTOMATION · AI

I replaced door-to-door prospecting with an AI-powered inbound machine.

Complete GTM system — statement analysis, automated routing, CRM logging, Slack alerts, and 7-email sequences. No engineering support. One week.

The merchant-facing results screen — built with Claude API and a custom JavaScript pricing engine
THE PROBLEM

Cold prospecting is broken — and expensive in ways nobody measures.

The traditional payment consultant playbook is physical drop-ins. Show up unannounced, interrupt the owner's day, pitch on the spot. Repeat 15–20 times a day. Close maybe one. Costs: time, gas, energy, reputation. It's the least scalable, most exhausting prospecting motion that exists — and it was the industry standard.

THE OLD WAY
✗Drive to businesses uninvited
✗Manually review statements (20–30 min each)
✗Log leads by hand to spreadsheet
✗Draft follow-ups from scratch
✗40–60 min of work per lead
THE NEW WAY
✓Merchant finds the tool themselves
✓AI analysis in 45 seconds
✓Auto-logged to CRM with 30+ fields
✓Slack alert with pre-written outreach
✓~2 min of work per lead

"The domain isn't 'save on processing.' It's amioverpaying.co — because that's the question the merchant is actually asking themselves."

WHAT I BUILT

6 layers. One week. No engineers.

01Lead Capture Tool
Multi-step form at amioverpaying.co. PDF statement upload. 6 result screens based on lead classification. No email gate — merchants see results before giving contact info.
02AI Analysis Engine (Claude API)
Extracts total fees, effective rate, fee breakdown, red flags, ISV qualification signals, and Derek's estimated monthly income from the account. Structured JSON output.
03JavaScript Pricing Engine (independent from AI)
Three-tier markup based on ticket size. Conservative and optimistic savings range. Math kept separate from AI deliberately — no hallucinated numbers on a decision a prospect makes.
04Make.com Automation — 6 modules, 5 routing branches
Webhook → Google Sheets → Router → Slack #leads-email · #leads-text · #isv-qualified · #isv-unqualified · Dropbox · Gmail. 30+ data fields logged per lead automatically.
05Google Sheets CRM
Auto-populated with formula columns. 9-stage status dropdown. Apps Script running every 5 min to reapply validations after Make.com writes rows.
067 Email Sequences
Complete sequences for every lead type — SMB with real savings, low savings, no statement, booked Calendly, ISV qualified, ISV not qualified. All stop automatically when Status changes from New.
WHAT I OWNED
✓Full system architecture and workflow design
✓Prompt engineering for AI statement analysis — structured JSON output, fee categorization, ISV qualification
✓JavaScript pricing engine — tiered markup logic, conservative/optimistic range calculation
✓Make.com scenario — 6 modules, 5 routing branches, webhook design, error handling
✓Google Sheets CRM schema, formula columns, Apps Script automation
✓All 7 email sequences — copy, personalization tokens, trigger logic
✓UX and copy for 6 distinct result screens
✓Domain, Cloudflare proxy, GitHub Pages deployment, QA and debugging

The AI writes code I direct. The thinking, architecture, and business logic are mine.

REFLECTION

The biggest lesson wasn't technical — it was psychological. The domain name converts because it addresses the merchant's actual internal question, not the consultant's pitch.

Knowing when NOT to use AI is part of AI fluency. I kept the savings math in JavaScript because a prospect making a business decision deserves a deterministic number.

THE MARKET GAP

A $12M+ market that sells knowledge but not execution.

Top LinkedIn creators have built massive businesses teaching people what to do. But course completion rates are "ridiculously low" — admitted publicly by the people selling them. People buy knowledge. They don't buy a system that makes them execute. That's the gap Arthur fills.

THE OLD WAY
✗Buy a $500 LinkedIn course
✗Read 40 lessons, lose momentum
✗Post occasionally, no strategy
✗No idea what's working
✗Quit after 3 weeks
THE ARTHUR WAY
✓Daily single action — no decision fatigue
✓Post scored before you publish
✓Stories surfaced through AI interview
✓AI tracks what's working
✓Leads come to you over time
Live Arthur dashboard — daily brief, analytics, coaching system
WHAT I BUILT

7 core systems in one product.

01Onboarding + Arthur Score
5-step onboarding. Arthur Score 0–100 diagnosis, growth phase identification, 3 immediate actions. Headline optimizer. Origin story builder. Engineered for 3 aha moments in under 5 minutes.
02Write and Coach
Post scoring 1–10. 8 content format types. Algorithm check: automated green checkmarks for no-link posts, optimal length, hook placement. Redraft with score comparison.
03Story Unlocked
AI interviewer surfaces stories the user already has. Outputs a Story Blueprint — intentionally NOT a finished post. Never ghostwrite. Authenticity is the moat and the account safety guarantee.
04My Posts + Analytics
Full post log. Optional metrics tracking. Trend charts. After 30 days: knows their optimal posting time based on their specific audience.
05My Plan
90-day goal arc meter. Daily checklist. Weekly targets by growth phase. The Arthur Method: 28 short guides covering profile, content, algorithm, engagement.
06Arthur Feed
Engagement tracker. Comment coaching — user writes, Arthur coaches. Never auto-posts. Comment automation is the fastest way to get an account flagged.
07Admin Dashboard
MRR from Stripe, signups, tier breakdown, user activity, CSV exports, feature request management. Built the ops layer too.
WHAT I OWNED
✓Full product architecture and feature roadmap V1/V2/V3
✓All AI system prompts — post scoring, story unlocking, headline optimization, pattern recognition, onboarding diagnosis
✓Database schema design and row-level security (Supabase)
✓Pricing strategy and tier logic — cost modeled at scale before launching
✓Both landing pages — individual users and sales team audience
✓All 28 guides in The Arthur Method playbook
✓Re-engagement email sequences for 5 drop-off scenarios
✓23 custom Posthog analytics events and funnel tracking

I applied to 100+ companies and watched the chaos. So I built the fix.

Gmail-connected job search OS that automatically imports applications, tracks rejections and interviews, and keeps you organized without any manual input.

Live dashboard — 34 applications tracked, Gmail connected, stages auto-updated
THE PROBLEM

Job searching is operationally broken.

50+ applications across 10+ platforms with a spreadsheet that collapses by week 3. Confirmation emails buried. Rejection emails unread. Existing tools (Huntr, Teal, Simplify) require manual data entry for everything — pretty interface, same broken process.

THE OLD WAY
✗Apply across 10+ platforms, no central record
✗Update spreadsheet manually every time
✗Rejection emails buried and missed
✗No idea where you stand with anyone
✗Spreadsheet collapses after week 3
MY APPLY CRM
✓Connect Gmail once — never again
✓Applications auto-imported
✓Rejections auto-update status
✓Pipeline always accurate
✓Zero manual input after setup
THE ARCHITECTURE

The two-pass parsing system.

PASS 1 — CONFIRMATION DETECTION
Gmail scan→ Subject regex→ Extracted ✓ (free)
Regex fails→ Claude Haiku reads body→ Company + role ✓
AI only called when regex fails. Keeps costs near-zero at scale.
PASS 2 — STATUS UPDATE DETECTION
Keyword scan→ AI classifies type→ Fuzzy match to app→ Stage auto-updates ✓
Handles rejections, interviews, and offers. If rejection arrives with no prior confirmation — created directly as Rejected.
WHY THIS MATTERS

Regex is free and instant. Claude Haiku is paid and slower. Running AI on every email burns budget on cases a three-line regex handles. The hybrid approach is a real-world cost optimization pattern. I learned it after burning API credits on emails regex would have handled instantly.

Refresh token architecture
Gmail stays connected permanently. No re-auth friction that kills retention.
Two separate sync passes
Confirmations and status updates have different email patterns. Better accuracy, lower cost.
Vercel over Supabase Edge Functions
Edge Functions had infrastructure issues on the free tier. Made the call, moved on.
Trial + freemium hybrid
7-day full access trial. Job searches last 3–6 months — no annual plan needed. Trial dates set via Supabase DB trigger on signup.
WHAT I OWNED
✓Full system architecture — two-pass parsing design, cost optimization strategy
✓Gmail OAuth integration and refresh token architecture
✓AI prompt engineering for email classification — 4 types, structured JSON output
✓Hybrid parsing pipeline — regex-first, AI-second
✓Database schema and Supabase trigger design
✓Plan gating system and 7-day trial mechanics
✓All product decisions, UX flow, and feature prioritization

The AI writes code I direct. The thinking, architecture, and business logic are mine.

"I'm not an AI engineer. I'm a commercial operator who learned to build with AI. That's the profile the next decade needs."

CASE STUDY · GTM STRATEGY · BRAND · POSITIONING · WEB

Built a backyard office brand from scratch — lean model, no lot, no overhead.

Premium backyard workspace brand built on a remote, asset-light GTM model. No lot rent. No W2 employees. No inventory risk. Partner builders fulfill the work.

Brand StrategyGTM DesignPositioningCopywritingWeb (Wix)Canva
KODIAK
Backyard Office
"Your best work doesn't happen
at the kitchen table."
THE INSIGHT

The traditional shed dealer model is broken by design.

Most dealers: rent a lot, stock inventory, hire staff, wait for foot traffic. Every lever for growth requires more capital and more risk. The insight: the lot isn't the product. The workspace is. Partner with a builder who handles fulfillment and you just need the brand, the positioning, and a website.

TRADITIONAL MODEL
✗$3–8k/mo lot rent before first sale
✗Inventory — theft, weather, vandalism
✗W2 employees, payroll, HR, turnover
✗Scale = more lots = more risk
✗Tied to one geography
KODIAK MODEL
✓$0 overhead before first sale
✓No inventory, no theft risk
✓No W2 employees — partner builder fulfills
✓Scale = add affiliate builders, not lots
✓Local feel. National reach.
THE COPY

Positioning in practice.

Hero headline
"Your best work doesn't happen at the kitchen table."
How it works
"From empty backyard to your best workspace — in weeks, not months."
Brand positioning
"Local feel. National reach. No lot required."

"Positioning is the highest-leverage work in any business. You can have the best product on the market and lose to a competitor with a worse product and a better story."

ABOUT ME

I build things because I can't leave broken
processes alone.

I spent 9 years in B2B sales — SaaS, adtech, payment processing. I was good at it. But I kept bumping into the same problem: the systems behind the sales motion were broken, manual, and slow. Nobody was fixing them.

So I took an intentional year to go deep on AI. Not dabbling. Actually building — until I understood how to turn business problems into systems that run themselves.

THE JOURNEY

How I got here.

2014 — 2022
Carried the bag in SaaS and adtech
Cold calling, building books of business, closing deals under pressure. Hit 247% of quota in my best year. Managed 8 AEs to 150% of team target. Learned how revenue really works — and where it breaks.
2022 — 2024
Started seeing the gaps
Every sales role had the same broken processes underneath it. Manual follow-up. CRMs nobody trusted. No automation. No leverage. I started studying RevOps and workflow design, and got interested in what was becoming possible with AI.
2024 — 2025
Went all-in
Took an intentional year to develop myself. Not a course. Actually building. Launched SouthCountry Cleaning from scratch using GoHighLevel, automated scheduling, and 1099 worker management. Shut it down in two months because I hated cleaning. Learned I loved building.
2025 — Now
Shipping real products
Three AI-powered products — a complete GTM inbound funnel for a payment consulting practice, a LinkedIn coaching SaaS with Stripe payments and real users, and a Gmail-connected job search CRM. All without engineering support. All under $50 each. All live.
HOW I WORK

What you can expect from me.

🔧
I fix broken things
If a process is slow, manual, or leaking value I'm going to want to fix it. That's not a job description — it's how I'm wired.
📐
I design before I build
Every system I've shipped started with the business problem, not the tool. Architecture first. Code second. Ship third.
🤝
I work through people
9 years of sales taught me that relationships are the actual operating system. I lead with trust and I build for the end user.
📈
I play to win
247% quota didn't happen by accident. I set high targets, track progress obsessively, and don't stop until it's done.

Advert
Two-sided platform · Consumers + Advertisers
Concept stage

"At SiriusXM I kept getting calls from listeners asking: 'Can you track the ads I heard?' They wanted to find them again. Nobody had built a way to save ads you actually wanted."

Advertisers wrap their ads in Advert's technology, making them saveable with a button on any device. Voice integrations let listeners say "save this ad." Users get an ad wallet — all saved ads in one place.

FOR USERS
✓ Save ads you actually liked
✓ Access when you have time
✓ Exclusive offers for saving
✓ Free — always
FOR ADVERTISERS
✓ Identify hand-raisers
✓ Retarget with precision
✓ In-app offers to savers
✓ "You saved this" reminder push
